capabilities.title: Validate a target-specific preset restore path

integrity-checked source backup and expected hash

FM3/Axe-Fx III have synthetic toolkit coverage only; external FM3 audition claim is separate. Interrupted recovery, conversion and batches remain unqualified.

capabilities.title: Verify persistent edits and preservation
capabilities.evidence_scope: Common independent preservation checkers cover Scene MIDI editing, isolated insertion/removal and full restoration. FM9 12.00 saved/reloaded PC/CC editing and explicit undo passed, including two-target Claude batches. Ordinary isolated removal and receipt-based insertion undo passed through Claude with complete original equality. Independent full final saved inventories found all 512 captures unchanged. Other-model hardware and arbitrary block families remain unqualified.

capabilities.evidence_scope: Offline same-slot comparison reports a one-based before-to-after scene map only for a unique byte-exact permutation of known scene fields with every other decoded body byte unchanged. Identical scenes, unsupported layouts and unexplained changes remain unresolved. This does not establish sound identity or all editor scene semantics.

capabilities.title: Research live device notifications and bounded refresh

capabilities.title: Find and safely undo owned Scene MIDI changes

Exact-result whole-backup undo and unfinished recovery records remain separate. General connected block removal is available.

capabilities.title: Find firmware-available amps absent from saved presets
capabilities.evidence_scope: Offline roster set difference requires exact model/firmware and complete established-capacity captures with decoded Amp fields. Partial or undecodable coverage returns unknown absence; no firmware availability is inferred from used IDs.

capabilities.title: Plan insertion of a block instance at a chosen cell
inputs: normalized saved snapshot with complete grid
capabilities.evidence_scope: Explicit coordinates or first-isolated-empty automatic placement and exact-instance reuse across all models. Shared isolated execution checks use destination masks and permit unrelated routes. These additions have synthetic coverage only. Isolated insertion has separate FM9 12.00 physical qualification for one caller-selected audio type across 52 test targets. The earlier Scene MIDI empty-preset pilot is separately scoped. Exact-firmware availability/DSP/default catalogues, arbitrary families and other-model hardware remain unqualified.

capabilities.title: Persist an already-loaded preset with complete saved verification

Expected file was not transmitted. Common save scopes for FM9/FM3/Axe-Fx III have synthetic coverage. This save-only record did not qualify full upload/reload; current restore evidence is separate. Other-model hardware and batches remain unqualified.

fresh exact result saved hash, unchanged live buffer and model/firmware/scene

FM9 12.00 populated two-target PC/CC editing and whole-backup undo passed; selective undo has all-model synthetic coverage only. Unfinished recovery items, cable/power loss, other-model hardware and automatic rollback remain unqualified.

capabilities.title: Resume interrupted Scene MIDI changes from retained original and verified result records

exact model/capacity/firmware and exclusively coordinated MIDI ports

verified continuation without blind replay and later-edit protection
private complete inventory and failure evidence

In-flight field/upload/Save interruption, cable or power loss, and later-edit conflicts retain synthetic or unknown scope. Other-model hardware, other historical record states/releases, migration of interrupted recovery states, selective merging of unfinished records, and automatic rollback remain unqualified.
